treaty_name: Agreement between Romania and the State of Kuwait for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1992)
eif_quote: ANAF list: Kuwait | 5/08.03.1993 | 57/1993 | 01.01.1992; EIF 05-10-1994 per Romania's MLI position (treaty map)

rates.quote: dar dacă primitorul este din beneficiarul efectiv al dividendelor, impozitul astfel stabilit nu va depăşi 1% (unu la sută) din suma brută a dividendelor.
dar, dacă beneficiarul efectiv al dobânzilor este rezident al celuilalt stat contractant, impozitul astfel stabilit nu va depăşi 1% (unu la sută) din suma brută a dobânzilor.
dar dacă primitorul este beneficiarul efectiv al redevenţelor, impozitul astfel stabilit nu va depăşi 20% (douăzeci la sută) din suma brută a redevenţelor.

ppt.basis: No MLI coverage (Kuwait signed but not ratified the MLI); no PPT in treaty

notes: Art. 30(2): retroactive effect — WHT on income due/payable on or after 1 January of the calendar year in which the agreement was signed (1992). Dividends/interest exempt (taxable only in residence State) when beneficial owner is the other State's government/institutions (Art. 4(2)(b),(c)) or a company ≥51% (dividends) / ≥25% (interest) government-owned with remaining capital held by resident nationals. Royalty definition excludes equipment rental and know-how. Signature date per treaty text: 25 July 1992 (treaty map has 1992-07-26). Kuwait MLI position reportedly gives EIF 1/1/1995 vs RO 05-10-1994 (map conflict, unresolved).
unverified: entry_into_force 1994-10-05 (RO MLI position; Kuwait MLI position conflict)
